refinement_plan_1.analysis: Based on review feedback, the following high-priority issues must be addressed: (1) CQ3: There is no explicit n-ary relation linking Organization, Role, and Invoice for querying the specific role an organization plays in a given invoice. (2) CQ13: There is no class or property to specify required/mandatory fields for file format validity. Medium-priority: (3) CQ5: Organization only has name and address; missing contact, registration, or legal details. (4) CQ8: Item only has description and net price; missing quantity, unit, product code. Medium/low-priority: (5) Add owl:someValuesFrom and cardinality restrictions for required relations (e.g., Invoice must have at least one buyer, seller, item). (6) Add owl:equivalentClass axioms for well-defined concepts. Plan: 1. Add a Participation pivot class (Organization-Role-Invoice) with appropriate properties. 2. Add a FileFormatRequirement class or annotation property to mark mandatory fields. 3. Expand Organization (contact info, registration) and Item (quantity, unit, product code). 4. Add OWL restrictions for required relations. 5. Add equivalence axioms for BuyerRole/SellerRole if feasible. 6. Preserve all existing correct modeling and annotations.
